result.title: Plant Stock and Dispatch Records
result.text:
Plant Stock and Dispatch Records
 This document records stock and dispatch at the plants of a manufacturer of packaged consumer goods. The
daily production and daily sales-order quantities of every product are real company records (day 1 is
2023-01-01). Stock, shipments and backorders are not recorded by the company: they are computed from those
records by the stock and dispatch policy stated below, applied exactly.
The document is divided into chapters titled 'Plant <id>, Period <NN>'. A period is 14 consecutive days; period 01
is days 1 to 14, period 02 is days 15 to 28, and so on. Questions refer to a chapter by that title. Days are
numbered from day 1 and each day's calendar date is given next to it.
Each chapter has four sections. 'Products' lists the products dispatched by the plant, with product group,
sub-group, storage location, weight per unit and opening stock. 'Daily ledger' gives, for every day of the period
and every product, the units produced, the units ordered that day, the units shipped, the units backordered at the
end of the day and the stock at the end of the day. 'Events' lists, in time order, the days on which the dispatch
capacity was reached, products ran out of stock, orders were fully backordered and backlogs were cleared.
'Order book' gives, for the 7 days after the period, the orders already received and the production already
planned; these quantities are exactly what then happened.
Stock and dispatch policy. Each plant dispatches all of its products from one storage location with one truck
fleet. Every period is an independent run: on its first day each product starts with its opening stock and there are
no open orders. Then, every day, in this order:
1. Production arrives. The day's production of each product is added to its stock.
2. Orders join the queue. The day's sales order of each product, if it is above zero, becomes one order (product,
quantity, day placed). Orders not completely shipped on earlier days stay in the queue with their remaining
quantity (they are backordered).
3. Dispatch. The plant has a daily dispatch capacity in kilograms, shared by all of its products. Open orders are
served one at a time, oldest first; among orders placed on the same day, the one with the smaller remaining
quantity goes first, then the lower product code (alphabetical order). Each order ships as many whole units as
both the product's stock and the capacity still unused that day allow (a unit uses its weight in capacity). Whatever
it cannot ship stays open, and the next order is served. Capacity used by one product is not available to the other
products that day; unused capacity is not carried over to the next day.
4. Records. The ledger row of a product for a day gives: produced (units that arrived), ordered (quantity of the
order placed that day, 0 if none), shipped (units shipped that day, for all of its orders together), backordered (units
of all its open orders at the end of the day) and stock (units on hand at the end of the day). Stock at the end of a
day = stock at the end of the previous day + produced - shipped; backordered = previous backordered + ordered
- shipped.
Terms used in the Events section and in questions. A product runs out of stock on a day when, at the end of
that day, it has no stock while some of its units are backordered; the Events section lists the first day of each
such run of days. The dispatch capacity is reached on a day when at least one order shipped fewer units than its
product's stock would have allowed because the remaining capacity was too small. An order is fully backordered
when nothing of it ships on the day it is placed. A product's backlog is cleared when its backordered units return
to 0. An order ships in full on a day when all of its units ship that day.
Constants. Opening stock of a product = 3 x its mean daily order over days 1 to 14, rounded to whole units (the
same in every period; listed in each chapter's Products table). Daily dispatch capacity: Plant 1912: 34500 kg per
day, Plant 1914: 192950 kg per day, Plant 2103: 407700 kg per day, Plant 2114: 300000 kg per day. Each
capacity is the 80th percentile of the plant's daily ordered weight over the whole record, rounded to the nearest
50 kg.
Units. Quantities are whole units (cases); weights in kilograms (kg). Recorded quantities are rounded to whole
units.
Chapters in this document (mfg_d05): Plant 2114, Period 03, Plant 1914, Period 05, Plant 1912, Period 06, Plant
2103, Period 07, Plant 2114, Period 07, Plant 1914, Period 08, Plant 1914, Period 09, Plant 2114, Period 10,
Plant 2114, Period 11, Plant 1912, Period 13, Plant 1912, Period 14.
